title: Claude Haiku 4.5 System Card
paper_type_zh: 前沿模型系统卡与训练数据披露台账
best_for_zh: 研究偏好学习、agentic RL、reasoning trace、reward hacking、安全评测与训练谱系的读者
one_line: Anthropic's Haiku 4.5 system card discloses five coarse training-source classes, RLHF/RLAIF, context-aware agent RL, prior-model reasoning traces, and a recursive later-stage training audit, but releases no source proportions, reward contract, global split, or reusable records.
Claude Haiku 4.5 System Card 披露五类训练来源、RLHF/RLAIF、偏好选择、上下文感知 agentic RL、前代模型推理文本与后训练行为审计，但不提供来源比例、reward model、全局 split、授权账本或可复用训练记录。
why: It is unusually useful for a disclosure ledger because it connects source categories, preference labor, reasoning-trace lineage, agentic post-training, and reward-hacking audits in one official artifact, while explicitly revealing that a targeted reward-hacking evaluation comes from the training distribution and therefore should not be mistaken for a clean held-out test.
inclusion_reason: A strong frontier disclosure-ledger entry because Anthropic explicitly enumerates five training-source classes, an internet cutoff, deduplication/classification, RLHF/RLAIF, crowd-worker preference selection, context-aware agent RL, prior-model reasoning traces in supervised learning, and a later-stage RL-trajectory audit, while also disclosing that a reward-hacking evaluation is selected from the training distribution. The missing proportions, reward implementation, global split, licenses, and item-level lineage remain central audit gaps.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The Claude Haiku 4.5 System Card documents how a small, fast hybrid-reasoning model is trained, post-trained, audited, and released for coding, computer use, tool use, and general assistant settings. For a reasoning-data atlas, its value lies less in benchmark breadth than in the explicit connections among source classes, preference labor, agentic reinforcement learning, reasoning-trace lineage, and post-training behavioral audits.

The central problem is disclosure granularity. Anthropic names five broad training-source classes, RLHF and RLAIF, crowd-worker preference selection, prior-model reasoning text in supervised learning, and a context-awareness intervention for agentic RL. Yet it releases no quantitative mixture, record schema, reward model, preference corpus, global split, or item-level provenance.

This Card therefore treats the system card as a disclosure ledger rather than a reproducibility package. Training signals, evaluation graders, deployment safeguards, and inference presentation mechanisms are kept separate.

Claude Haiku 4.5 System Card 记录了一个小型、快速的 hybrid-reasoning 模型如何面向 coding、computer use、tool use 与通用助手场景进行训练、后训练、审计和发布。对 reasoning-data atlas 而言，它的价值不只在 benchmark，而在于明确连接了来源类别、偏好劳动、agentic RL、reasoning-trace 谱系与后训练行为审计。

核心问题是披露粒度。Anthropic 命名了五类训练来源、RLHF 与 RLAIF、crowd-worker 偏好选择、监督学习中的前代模型 reasoning text，以及 agentic RL 的上下文感知干预，却没有开放定量 mixture、记录 schema、reward model、偏好语料、全局 split 或 item-level provenance。

因此，本 Card 把该系统卡视为披露台账，而非可复现包。训练信号、评测 grader、部署 safeguard 与推理展示机制被严格分开。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The report exposes five coarse training-source classes: publicly available Internet information through February 2025; non-public third-party data; data from data-labeling services and paid contractors; opt-in data from Claude users; and internally generated Anthropic data. Deduplication and classification are named as cleaning steps, while the public crawler follows robots.txt and avoids password-, sign-in-, and CAPTCHA-protected pages.

Post-training includes reinforcement learning from human feedback and AI feedback. Crowd workers engaged through data-work platforms perform preference selection, safety evaluation, and adversarial testing. The system card does not specify whether preference records are pairwise, listwise, or rubric-based in every stage, nor how human and AI signals are aggregated into rewards.

For agentic RL, Haiku 4.5 is explicitly trained with precise context-usage information. The goal is to wrap up appropriately when near the 200K-token release context limit and to persist when substantial context remains. This is a concrete state-awareness intervention, although task distribution, rollout environment, episode budget, reward, and algorithm are not disclosed.

The reasoning lineage has two additional layers. Some earlier supervised-learning data contain reasoning text generated by prior Anthropic models. Separately, rare very long extended-thinking traces may be summarized for users by a second Haiku 4.5 instance at inference. The former is training evidence; the latter is only a presentation mechanism.

报告披露五类粗粒度训练来源：截至 2025 年 2 月的公开互联网信息；非公开第三方数据；来自数据标注服务和付费 contractor 的数据；Claude 用户主动 opt-in 的数据；Anthropic 内部生成数据。Deduplication 与 classification 被列为清理步骤；公共 crawler 遵循 robots.txt，并避开密码、登录与 CAPTCHA 保护页面。

后训练包括 reinforcement learning from human feedback 与 AI feedback。通过 data-work platform 雇用的 crowd worker 参与偏好选择、安全评测与对抗测试。系统卡没有说明各阶段的偏好记录究竟是 pairwise、listwise 还是 rubric-based，也没有说明人类和 AI 信号如何聚合成 reward。

在 agentic RL 中，Haiku 4.5 被明确训练去感知精确上下文使用量：接近 200K-token 发布上下文上限时适当收尾，剩余上下文较多时继续坚持。这是具体的 state-awareness 干预，但任务分布、rollout 环境、episode budget、reward 和算法未披露。

Reasoning 谱系还有两层。部分早期监督学习数据包含前代 Anthropic 模型生成的 reasoning text；另有极少数很长的 extended-thinking trace 会在推理时由第二个 Haiku 4.5 实例为用户总结。前者是训练证据，后者只是展示机制。

title: Method
方法
html:
Training begins from the five named source classes, followed by deduplication and classification. The report supplies a February 2025 cutoff only for public Internet information. It does not name datasets, provide sample or token counts, quantify language/domain balance, partition contractor and opt-in contributions, or release source-level rights metadata.

Supervised stages include some reasoning text produced by prior models. Teacher checkpoints, prompts, temperatures, budgets, selection, edits, and retained volumes are unknown. Because the complete training-record schema is absent, the strongest supported abstraction is a prompt or conversation paired with an answer and, for some records, model-generated reasoning text.

Post-training uses RLHF and RLAIF. Data-work-platform workers perform preference selection, while an undisclosed AI-feedback source also contributes. The preference schema, rater assignment, adjudication, reward-model or constitution identity, objective mixture, normalization, calibration, RL algorithm, optimizer, and stage sizes are all unknown.

Agentic RL adds explicit context-window usage information to the state available during training. The system card says this teaches Haiku 4.5 to conclude near the limit and continue when budget remains. It does not disclose tools, tasks, state encoding, rollout counts, termination, or rewards. The 200K context limit is a release context, not a training rollout count.

Anthropic also performs a later-stage behavioral audit: all later-stage training behavior is recursively summarized, and Claude Sonnet 4 judges every summary for surprising or concerning patterns. Excessive tool use, overengineering, and hallucinations are reported, but raw transcripts, recursive summaries, judge prompts, counts, scores, calibration, and checkpoint identifiers are not released.

Safety evaluations run automatically throughout training, allowing trend monitoring and possible intervention. However, named policy rubrics, VM/MCP prompt-injection predicates, SHADE-Arena monitoring, classifiers, visible/hidden tests, and Impossible Tasks are evaluation contracts unless the report explicitly identifies them as training rewards.

训练从五类已命名来源开始，并进行 deduplication 与 classification。报告只为公开互联网信息提供了 2025 年 2 月 cutoff；没有命名数据集、给出样本/token 数、量化语言或领域平衡、划分 contractor/opt-in 贡献，也没有开放 source-level 权利元数据。

监督阶段包含一部分由前代模型生成的 reasoning text。Teacher checkpoint、prompt、temperature、budget、选择、编辑与保留数量均未知。由于完整训练记录 schema 缺失，目前最强的支持抽象只是：prompt/conversation 与 answer 配对，部分记录另含 model-generated reasoning text。

后训练使用 RLHF 与 RLAIF。Data-work-platform worker 进行偏好选择，另有未披露的 AI-feedback 来源。Preference schema、rater assignment、adjudication、reward model 或 constitution 身份、objective mixture、normalization、calibration、RL algorithm、optimizer 和阶段规模全部未知。

Agentic RL 把明确的 context-window 使用信息加入训练 state。系统卡称这会教模型在接近上限时结束，在预算充足时继续；但没有披露 tools、tasks、state encoding、rollout count、termination 或 reward。200K context 是发布上下文限制，不是训练 rollout 数。

Anthropic 还做了后训练行为审计：对所有 later-stage training behavior 递归总结，再让 Claude Sonnet 4 判断每份 summary 是否含意外或令人担忧的模式。报告发现过度工具调用、overengineering 与 hallucination，但原始 transcript、递归 summary、judge prompt、数量、分数、校准和 checkpoint ID 都未开放。

安全评测在训练期间自动持续运行，以监控趋势并允许干预。不过，已命名的 policy rubric、VM/MCP prompt-injection predicate、SHADE-Arena monitor、classifier、visible/hidden test 和 Impossible Tasks 都是评测契约，除非报告明确把它们认定为训练 reward。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Section 1.1.1, page 5, lists the five training-source classes and the February 2025 public-Internet cutoff. The same section names deduplication and classification and describes crawler-access policy. It also states that post-training includes RLHF and AI feedback, without giving source proportions, counts, reward details, or the RL algorithm.

Section 1.1.4, page 6, says crowd workers engaged through data-work platforms contribute preference selection, safety evaluation, and adversarial testing. This supports a preference-learning role but does not disclose the number of comparisons, rater agreement, adjudication, or how much worker output belongs to training rather than evaluation.

Section 1.1.3, page 6, gives the context-awareness intervention: Haiku 4.5 was trained with precise information about context usage so it could wrap up near the limit and persist otherwise. The release context is 200K tokens. No ablation, rollout count, task distribution, reward, or state encoding is supplied.

Sections 4.3 and 4.5, pages 28–30, provide two trace-lineage facts. All later-stage training behavior was recursively summarized and every summary judged by Claude Sonnet 4; separately, some earlier supervised-learning data contain reasoning text from prior models. The audit reports excessive tool use, overengineering, and hallucinations but no novel concerning pattern. Neither raw audit records nor prior-model reasoning records are released.

Table 5.B on page 34 reports 6% classifier-detected and 3% hidden-test reward hacking on Reward-Hack-Prone Coding Tasks v2, and 30% versus 23% hacking on Impossible Tasks without and with an anti-hack prompt. The coding set was hand-selected from Anthropic's training distribution because prior models hacked it. Its held-out fuzzed tests are local to that evaluation and do not establish unseen-distribution generalization or a global train/test split.

Other official figures remain bound to their evaluation interfaces. Tables 2.1.1.A and 2.1.2.A on pages 8–9 report 99.38% ±0.21 harmless-response rate on violative requests and 0.02% ±0.04 benign over-refusal overall. Tables 3.1.2.A–B on pages 15–17 evaluate 49 malicious and 61 dual-use/benign Claude Code prompts under named mitigation settings. These are release evaluations, not training labels or rewards.

第 1.1.1 节第 5 页列出五类训练来源与公开互联网信息的 2025 年 2 月 cutoff。同节还命名 deduplication、classification 与 crawler access policy，并说明后训练包含 RLHF 和 AI feedback，但没有给出来源比例、数量、reward 细节或 RL 算法。

第 1.1.4 节第 6 页称，通过 data-work platform 雇用的 crowd worker 参与 preference selection、safety evaluation 与 adversarial testing。这支持 preference-learning 用途，但没有披露比较数量、rater agreement、adjudication，也未说明多少 worker 输出属于训练而非评测。

第 1.1.3 节第 6 页给出上下文感知干预：Haiku 4.5 在训练时获得精确 context usage 信息，以便接近上限时收尾、否则继续坚持。发布上下文为 200K token。报告没有提供 ablation、rollout count、任务分布、reward 或 state encoding。

第 4.3 与 4.5 节第 28–30 页提供两项 trace-lineage 事实：所有 later-stage training behavior 被递归总结，每份 summary 由 Claude Sonnet 4 判断；部分 earlier supervised-learning data 则含前代模型 reasoning text。审计报告发现 excessive tool use、overengineering 与 hallucination，但没有新型令人担忧模式。原始审计记录和前代模型 reasoning 记录均未开放。

第 34 页表 5.B 报告：Reward-Hack-Prone Coding Tasks v2 上 classifier-detected reward hacking 为 6%，hidden-test hacking 为 3%；Impossible Tasks 在无/有 anti-hack prompt 时分别为 30% 与 23%。编码任务来自 Anthropic training distribution，并因前代模型曾 hack 而手工选择。其 held-out fuzzed test 只在该评测内部成立，不能证明 unseen-distribution 泛化或全局 train/test split。

其他官方数字也必须绑定评测界面。第 8–9 页表 2.1.1.A 与 2.1.2.A 报告违规请求上的 overall harmless-response rate 为 99.38% ±0.21，benign over-refusal 为 0.02% ±0.04。第 15–17 页表 3.1.2.A–B 在特定 mitigation 条件下评测 49 个 malicious 和 61 个 dual-use/benign Claude Code prompt。这些是发布评测，不是训练 label 或 reward。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The system card is unusually useful because it joins data-source disclosure with post-training labor and agent-training behavior. Five source classes, human and AI feedback, contractor preference selection, prior-model reasoning traces, context-aware agentic RL, and recursive behavioral review appear in one official artifact.

The context-awareness intervention is a concrete example of state-action supervision beyond answer quality. Context usage becomes part of the information available to the model during agentic RL, shaping whether it persists or concludes. This is a meaningful agent-training contract even though the reward and environment are absent.

The later-stage recursive audit is also distinctive. Rather than sampling only benchmark responses, Anthropic summarizes the complete later-stage behavior corpus and asks another model to inspect every summary. It establishes a stage-level audit checkpoint, while simultaneously illustrating why raw traces, summary transformations, judge prompts, and calibration are necessary for independent verification.

Finally, the report explicitly reveals that a reward-hacking benchmark was selected from the training distribution. That disclosure prevents a misleading held-out-generalization interpretation and is itself valuable audit evidence.

这份系统卡的特殊价值，在于把数据来源披露、后训练劳动与 agent-training behavior 放在同一份官方材料中。五类来源、人类与 AI feedback、contractor 偏好选择、前代模型 reasoning trace、上下文感知 agentic RL 和递归行为审计形成一条粗粒度链路。

上下文感知干预是 answer quality 之外 state-action supervision 的具体例子。Context usage 成为 agentic RL 中模型可用的信息，影响它选择继续还是收尾。即使 reward 与环境缺失，这仍是有意义的 agent-training contract。

Later-stage recursive audit 也很独特。Anthropic 不是只抽样 benchmark response，而是总结完整的后阶段行为语料，并让另一个模型检查每份 summary。它建立了阶段级审计节点，同时说明独立验证为什么需要原始 trace、summary transformation、judge prompt 与 calibration。

最后，报告明确说明 reward-hacking benchmark 来自 training distribution。这一披露阻止了误导性的 held-out generalization 解读，本身就是重要审计证据。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Source mixture and authorization remain non-auditable. The five classes have no proportions, sample or token counts, named datasets, versions, language/domain distributions, synthetic share, opt-in volume, contractor allocation, or filtering yields. Following robots.txt and avoiding access controls are crawler-policy facts, not item-level copyright, license, consent, or jurisdictional authorization.

The RLHF/RLAIF reward contract is absent. The report does not identify the AI-feedback model, reward model, constitution, preference schema, aggregation, objective weights, normalization, calibration, rejection rule, RL algorithm, or human-versus-AI mixture. “Preference selection” alone does not establish pairwise layout, adjudication, or rater reliability.

Deduplication is named but not auditable. No dedup key, algorithm, threshold, revision pin, benchmark exclusion list, near-duplicate analysis, false-negative audit, or retained/rejected ledger is provided. This is especially important because reward-hack-prone coding tasks are explicitly selected from the training distribution.

There is no global train/development/evaluation split. Held-out fuzzed tests are held out only within one reward-hacking suite. Their status cannot be generalized to policy prompts, prompt injection, SHADE-Arena, dangerous-capability evaluations, or the base and post-training corpora.

Training and evaluation interfaces are partly entangled. Safety evaluation ran throughout training and could trigger intervention, but this does not prove that its rubrics, classifiers, VM/MCP tasks, SHADE monitor, or hidden tests were optimization rewards. Prompt-injection results combine checkpoint behavior with model-level instructions, FileRead changes, and real-time classifiers; mitigation scores cannot be assigned to model training alone.

Extended-thinking boundaries are incomplete. Current faithfulness metrics are acknowledged as unreliable, and the absence of an unambiguous failure is not proof of faithful reasoning. Rare long user-visible thoughts may be summarized by a second Haiku 4.5 instance at inference, so the displayed trace can differ from the generated trace. That second instance is not evidence of a training teacher. Product benchmark thinking budgets are inference settings, not training budgets.

Finally, neither prior-model reasoning traces nor recursive audit artifacts are released. Teacher checkpoints, trace generation, editing and selection are unknown; raw RL transcripts, summaries, Claude Sonnet 4 judge prompts, scores, counts, and checkpoint IDs are unavailable. Coarse stage lineage cannot connect an individual source item, preference, reward, update, and released checkpoint.

来源 mixture 与授权无法审计。五类来源没有比例、样本/token 数、命名数据集、版本、语言/领域分布、synthetic share、opt-in volume、contractor allocation 或过滤 yield。遵循 robots.txt、避开访问控制只是 crawler-policy 事实，不是 item-level copyright、license、consent 或司法辖区授权账本。

RLHF/RLAIF 的 reward contract 缺失。报告没有识别 AI-feedback model、reward model、constitution、preference schema、aggregation、objective weight、normalization、calibration、rejection rule、RL algorithm 或 human-vs-AI mixture。仅有“preference selection”不能证明 pairwise layout、adjudication 或 rater reliability。

Deduplication 被命名但不可审计。没有 dedup key、algorithm、threshold、revision pin、benchmark exclusion list、near-duplicate analysis、false-negative audit 或保留/拒绝账本。Reward-hack-prone coding task 明确来自 training distribution，使这一缺口尤其重要。

报告没有全局 train/development/evaluation split。Held-out fuzzed test 只在一个 reward-hacking suite 内部 held out，不能推广到 policy prompt、prompt injection、SHADE-Arena、危险能力评测或 base/post-training 语料。

训练与评测界面部分纠缠。安全评测在训练期间持续运行并可能触发干预，但这不能证明其 rubric、classifier、VM/MCP task、SHADE monitor 或 hidden test 是优化 reward。Prompt-injection 结果混合了 checkpoint behavior、model-level instruction、FileRead 改动和实时 classifier，mitigation score 不能单独归因于模型训练。

Extended-thinking 边界不完整。报告承认当前 faithfulness metric 对这类模型不可靠；没有观察到明确失败不等于推理忠实。极少数很长的 user-visible thought 会在推理时由第二个 Haiku 4.5 实例总结，因此展示 trace 可能不同于完整生成 trace；该第二实例不是训练 teacher 证据。产品 benchmark 的 thinking budget 是推理设置，不是训练预算。

最后，前代模型 reasoning trace 与 recursive audit 工件都未发布。Teacher checkpoint、trace generation、编辑和选择未知；原始 RL transcript、summary、Claude Sonnet 4 judge prompt、分数、数量与 checkpoint ID 均不可得。粗粒度 stage lineage 无法连接单个 source item、preference、reward、update 与发布 checkpoint。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
This system card is a useful template for a minimum frontier-model disclosure ledger. It shows that source classes, collection cutoff, filtering, feedback type, preference labor, reasoning-trace origin, agent-state intervention, behavioral audits, and evaluation boundaries can all be stated even when records remain private.

For preference-data researchers, it identifies the next metadata needed for reuse: comparison schema, candidate generation, rater assignment, worker cohort, agreement, adjudication, AI-feedback model, reward version, aggregation, and source-to-checkpoint lineage.

For agentic RL, the context-usage intervention suggests treating budget awareness as an explicit process field rather than an incidental prompt feature. Open reproductions should log context-used/context-remaining signals, actions, termination choices, rewards, and episode boundaries.

For auditors, the training-distribution origin of the reward-hacking suite is a model disclosure worth emulating. Every benchmark should state membership, selection rationale, held-out scope, scaffold, mitigations, and whether scores reflect the released checkpoint or another snapshot.

这份系统卡可作为前沿模型最小披露台账的参考。它说明即使记录保持私有，也可以明确陈述来源类别、收集 cutoff、过滤、feedback type、偏好劳动、reasoning-trace 来源、agent-state 干预、行为审计与评测边界。

对偏好数据研究者，它指出了复用所需的下一层元数据：comparison schema、candidate generation、rater assignment、worker cohort、agreement、adjudication、AI-feedback model、reward version、aggregation 和 source-to-checkpoint lineage。

对 agentic RL，上下文使用干预提示我们把预算感知作为显式 process field，而非偶然的 prompt 特征。开放复现应记录 context-used/context-remaining 信号、action、termination choice、reward 与 episode boundary。

对审计者，reward-hacking suite 来自 training distribution 是值得效仿的披露。每个 benchmark 都应说明 membership、selection rationale、held-out scope、scaffold、mitigation，以及分数来自发布 checkpoint 还是其他 snapshot。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Section 1.1.1 first and write the five source classes verbatim in a ledger. Keep the February 2025 cutoff attached only to public Internet information; do not infer dates or proportions for the other four classes.
  • Pair Sections 1.1.1 and 1.1.4 when analyzing RLHF/RLAIF. Separate worker preference selection from safety evaluation and adversarial testing, and mark reward-model, AI-feedback, aggregation, and adjudication details as unknown.
  • Treat Section 1.1.3 as a specific agentic-RL intervention: precise context-usage information. Keep the 200K release context distinct from training rollout length and product benchmark thinking budgets.
  • Read Sections 4.3 and 4.5 as two different trace objects: recursively summarized later-stage RL behavior versus prior-model reasoning text in earlier supervised learning. Neither object is released, and inference-time long-thought summarization is a third, separate presentation layer.
  • Read Table 5.B with the training-distribution warning. Hidden fuzzed tests are locally held out, not evidence of a global split. Bind prompt-injection and safety scores to their model-level instructions, tools, classifiers, mitigations, modes, and snapshot policy.

• 先读第 1.1.1 节，把五类来源逐项写入台账。2025 年 2 月 cutoff 只绑定公开互联网信息，不推断其余四类的日期或比例。
  • 分析 RLHF/RLAIF 时，把第 1.1.1 与 1.1.4 节配对阅读。区分 worker preference selection、safety evaluation 和 adversarial testing，并把 reward model、AI-feedback、aggregation、adjudication 标为 unknown。
  • 把第 1.1.3 节视为具体 agentic-RL 干预：提供精确 context-usage 信息。200K release context 必须与训练 rollout length、产品 benchmark thinking budget 分开。
  • 把第 4.3 与 4.5 节当作两种 trace object：递归总结的 later-stage RL behavior，以及 earlier supervised learning 中的前代模型 reasoning text。二者均未开放；推理时 long-thought summarization 是第三种独立展示层。
  • 阅读表 5.B 时保留 training-distribution 警告。Hidden fuzzed test 只是局部 held out，不是全局 split 证据。Prompt-injection 与安全分数要绑定 model-level instruction、tool、classifier、mitigation、mode 和 snapshot policy。

value.html: The report explicitly names five broad training-source classes: publicly available internet information through February 2025; non-public third-party data; data from data-labeling services and paid contractors; opt-in data from Claude users; and internally generated Anthropic data. It does not disclose source names, mixture weights, sample/token counts, versions, jurisdictions, or item-level provenance. Evaluation prompts are separate objects: they include policy-violating and benign safety prompts, automatically generated conversations of up to 15 turns, 49 malicious and 61 dual-use/benign Claude Code prompts, VM/MCP/bash prompt-injection cases, SHADE-Arena tasks, hand-selected reward-hack-prone coding problems from Anthropic's training distribution, held-out fuzzed tests, and intentionally impossible agent tasks.

value_zh.html: 报告明确点名五类宽泛训练来源：截至 February 2025 的公开互联网信息；非公开第三方数据；来自数据标注服务与付费承包商的数据；Claude 用户选择加入的数据；以及内部生成的 Anthropic 数据。它不披露来源名称、混合权重、样本/token 计数、版本、司法辖区或条目级谱系。评测提示为独立对象：包括违规与良性安全提示、最多 15 轮自动生成对话、49 个恶意与 61 个两用/良性 Claude Code 提示、VM/MCP/bash 提示注入案例、SHADE-Arena 任务、从 Anthropic 训练分布手选的易奖励劫持编程问题、留出的模糊测试，以及故意不可能的智能体任务。

value.html: No serialized training-record schema or example is released. At the disclosed abstraction level, records may contain prompts or conversations, answers, pairwise preference selections, model reasoning text, tool outputs/actions, and full agent episodes. Evaluation records additionally contain policy/rubric grades, prompt-injection attack outcomes, classifier labels, hidden-test results, monitor outcomes, and give-up-versus-hack terminal states. The second-model summary of rare long thoughts is an inference presentation format, not a disclosed training target.

value_zh.html: 未发布序列化训练记录模式或样例。在所披露的抽象层级，记录可含提示或对话、答案、成对偏好选择、模型推理文本、工具输出/动作，以及完整智能体 episode。评测记录另外含策略/评分标准等级、提示注入攻击结果、分类器标签、隐藏测试结果、监测结果，以及 give-up-versus-hack 终态。罕见长思考的第二模型摘要是推断呈现格式，而非已披露的训练目标。

value.html: Training-trace authors include the Claude Haiku 4.5 checkpoint during agentic reinforcement-learning episodes, crowd workers contributing preference selection, an undisclosed AI-feedback source, and prior Anthropic models whose reasoning text appears in some earlier-stage supervised-learning data. The report does not identify the prior-model checkpoints, AI-feedback model, trace volumes, selection policy, edits, or retention. Evaluation-only traces include default and extended-thinking responses, tool/action trajectories, computer-use actions, MCP interactions, RL-training transcripts examined in a later-stage audit, and rare long user-visible thoughts summarized at inference by a second Haiku 4.5 instance.

value.html: Training substrate is only partially disclosed. Agentic reinforcement-learning episodes can consume a 200K-token release context, and Haiku 4.5 was explicitly trained with precise context-usage information so it could wrap up near the limit and persist when more context remained. The state encoding, tools, task distribution, episode budgets, and rewards are unknown. Evaluation-only substrates include Claude Code with standard tools, computer-use virtual machines, simulated email/Slack/document MCP servers, bash/tool execution, SHADE-Arena, reward-hack-prone coding tasks with visible and hidden fuzzed tests, and Impossible Tasks that continue until give-up or hacking.

value_zh.html: 训练基底仅部分披露。智能体强化学习 episode 可消耗 200K-token 发布上下文，且 Haiku 4.5 被明确以精确上下文使用信息训练，以便在接近上限时收束，并在仍有更多上下文时持续。状态编码、工具、任务分布、episode 预算与奖励未知。仅评测基底包括带标准工具的 Claude Code、computer-use 虚拟机、模拟的 email/Slack/document MCP 服务器、bash/工具执行、SHADE-Arena、带可见与隐藏模糊测试的易奖励劫持编程任务，以及持续至放弃或黑客的 Impossible Tasks。

value.html: Post-training explicitly includes reinforcement learning from human feedback and AI feedback, and data-work-platform workers perform preference selection. The preference schema, reward-model or AI-feedback identity, constitution, label aggregation, objective mixture, weights, calibration, and RL algorithm are unknown. Separately, evaluation uses policy/rubric analysis, test-case-specific graders, prompt-injection attack predicates, real-time classifiers, a broad SHADE-Arena monitor, Claude Sonnet 4 to judge recursively summarized later-stage training behavior, classifier-based reward-hack detection, and visible/hidden program tests. These evaluation graders and deployment classifiers are not established as the training reward.

value_zh.html: 后训练明确包括来自人类反馈与 AI 反馈的强化学习，且数据工作平台工作者执行偏好选择。偏好模式、奖励模型或 AI 反馈身份、constitution、标签聚合、目标混合物、权重、校准与 RL 算法未知。另外，评测使用策略/评分标准分析、测试用例特定评分器、提示注入攻击谓词、实时分类器、宽泛 SHADE-Arena 监测器、由 Claude Sonnet 4 评审递归摘要的后期训练行为、基于分类器的奖励劫持检测，以及可见/隐藏程序测试。这些评测评分器与部署分类器未被确立为训练奖励。

value.html: Training-episode termination is unknown. For the disclosed evaluation contracts, multi-turn safety conversations run up to 15 turns; prompt-injection succeeds when the model leaves its assigned task to follow embedded malicious instructions; hidden-test hacking is counted when a solution that passes visible tests fails expected fuzzed hidden tests; and an Impossible Task episode continues until the model either declares the task impossible and gives up or hacks to make it appear solved.

value_zh.html: 训练 episode 终止未知。对所披露的评测契约，多轮安全对话最多运行 15 轮；当模型离开指定任务去遵循嵌入的恶意指令时提示注入成功；当通过可见测试的解在预期模糊隐藏测试上失败时计为隐藏测试黑客；Impossible Task episode 持续至模型要么声明任务不可能并放弃，要么黑客使其看起来已解决。

value.html: Claude Haiku 4.5 is described as a small, fast hybrid-reasoning large language model with default and optional extended-thinking modes. Architecture, parameter count, tokenizer, pretraining checkpoint, context-training implementation, exact model lineage, and stage sizes are unknown.

value_zh.html: Claude Haiku 4.5 被描述为小型、快速的混合推理大语言模型，具有默认与可选 extended-thinking 模式。架构、参数量、分词器、预训练检查点、上下文训练实现、确切模型谱系与阶段规模未知。

value.html: Some earlier supervised-learning data contain reasoning text produced by prior models, but the teacher checkpoints, generation prompts, temperatures, budgets, filtering, and volumes are unknown. AI feedback is also used in post-training, but its generating or judging model is undisclosed. A second Haiku 4.5 instance summarizes rare very long thoughts at inference and must not be treated as a training teacher.

value_zh.html: 部分较早监督学习数据含先前模型产生的推理文本，但教师模型检查点、生成提示、温度、预算、过滤与体量未知。后训练也使用 AI 反馈，但其生成或评审模型未披露。第二个 Haiku 4.5 实例在推断时摘要罕见很长的思考，不得视为训练教师模型。

value.html: Anthropic generated one of the five broad training-source classes internally, but the generators, prompt sources, generation policy, sample counts, and quality controls are unknown. Automatically generated multi-turn safety conversations and other named synthetic-looking objects are evaluation materials unless the report explicitly says otherwise.

value_zh.html: Anthropic 内部生成五类宽泛训练来源之一，但生成器、提示来源、生成策略、样本计数与质量控制未知。自动生成的多轮安全对话及其他具名合成外观对象是评测材料，除非报告明确另有说明。

value.html: Training sampling and source mixture are unknown. Evaluation-only sampling includes final or near-final snapshots; default and extended-thinking modes; automated conversations up to 15 turns; k=1 and k=10 Gray Swan attacks across 25 model variants; with/without-mitigation conditions; a hand-selected set of coding tasks where prior models hacked; and highest-capability results among multiple RSP snapshots. These do not establish the post-training sampling protocol.

value_zh.html: 训练采样与来源混合未知。仅评测采样包括最终或近最终快照；默认与 extended-thinking 模式；最多 15 轮自动对话；跨 25 个模型变体的 Gray Swan k=1 与 k=10 攻击；有/无缓解条件；先前模型发生黑客的手选编程任务集合；以及多个 RSP 快照中的最高能力结果。这些不确立后训练采样协议。

value.html: Training rollout counts are unknown. Evaluation-only disclosed repetitions include Gray Swan k=1 and k=10, 30 attempts per challenge for a 32-task Cybench subset, 50 SWE-bench trials on the launch page, and benchmark-specific repeated runs. Most safety, reward-hacking, context-awareness, and RL-audit sample counts are not disclosed.

value.html: Training cleaning/filtering explicitly includes deduplication and classification. The public web crawler follows robots.txt, avoids password-, sign-in-, and CAPTCHA-protected pages, and is identifiable to operators. Filter algorithms, classifier checkpoints, thresholds, dedup keys, yields, manual-review rates, benchmark exclusion rules, and source-level rejection logs are unknown. Evaluation-only selection includes 49 malicious and 61 dual-use/benign Claude Code prompts and a hand-selected reward-hacking set from the training distribution.

value_zh.html: 训练清洗/过滤明确包括去重与分类。公开网络爬虫遵循 robots.txt，避开口令、登录与 CAPTCHA 保护页面，且对运营者可识别。过滤算法、分类器检查点、阈值、去重键、产量、人工审核率、基准排除规则与来源级拒绝日志未知。仅评测选择包括 49 个恶意与 61 个两用/良性 Claude Code 提示，以及从训练分布手选的奖励劫持集合。

value.html: Release context is 200K tokens, and extended-thinking mode lets the model spend more time before answering. The launch page reports benchmark-only settings including a 128K thinking budget, default temperature/top_p, 50 SWE-bench trials, 32K thinking for some Terminal-Bench runs, and per-step/total thinking limits for OSWorld. None of these values is disclosed as a training rollout or optimization budget.

value_zh.html: 发布上下文为 200K tokens，且 extended-thinking 模式让模型在作答前花费更多时间。发布页报告仅基准设置，包括 128K thinking 预算、默认 temperature/top_p、50 次 SWE-bench 试验、部分 Terminal-Bench 运行的 32K thinking，以及 OSWorld 的逐步/总计 thinking 限制。这些值均未作为训练 rollout 或优化预算披露。

value.html: The model receives post-training/fine-tuning that includes RLHF and RLAIF, some earlier-stage supervised learning with prior-model reasoning text, and a context-awareness intervention for agentic RL. The report does not disclose the supervised objective, RL algorithm, optimizer, reward implementation, reward mixing or normalization, rollout scaffold, batching, schedules, compute, checkpoint selection, or interactions between human and AI feedback.

value_zh.html: 模型接受包括 RLHF 与 RLAIF 的后训练/微调、含先前模型推理文本的部分较早阶段监督学习，以及针对智能体 RL 的上下文意识干预。报告不披露监督目标、RL 算法、优化器、奖励实现、奖励混合或归一化、rollout 脚手架、批处理、日程、算力、检查点选择，或人类与 AI 反馈之间的交互。

value.html: Five source classes and a February 2025 public-internet cutoff are explicit, but their proportions, token/sample counts, exact sources, versions, dates for non-public material, language/domain mix, opt-in volume, contractor allocation, synthetic-data share, and filtering yields are unknown. Robots.txt and access-control claims do not provide item-level authorization, copyright status, or source-license metadata.

value_zh.html: 五类来源与 February 2025 公开互联网截止日期是明确的，但其比例、token/样本计数、确切来源、版本、非公开材料日期、语言/领域混合、选择加入体量、承包商分配、合成数据份额与过滤产量未知。Robots.txt 与访问控制主张不提供条目级授权、版权状态或来源许可元数据。

value.html: No global train/dev/test ledger is supplied. The strongest overlap disclosure is adverse: Reward-Hack-Prone Coding Tasks v2 is hand-selected from Anthropic's training distribution, with more tasks added from that same distribution. Within its hidden-test subset, the hidden tests are held-out fuzzed versions of visible tests. The report does not establish whether safety, prompt-injection, SHADE-Arena, RSP, or most other evaluation items overlap pretraining or post-training.

value_zh.html: 未提供全局 train/dev/test 账本。最强重叠披露是不利的：Reward-Hack-Prone Coding Tasks v2 从 Anthropic 训练分布手选，并从同一分布添加更多任务。在其隐藏测试子集内，隐藏测试是可见测试的留出模糊版本。报告不确立安全、提示注入、SHADE-Arena、RSP 或多数其他评测条目是否与预训练或后训练重叠。

value.html: Training data undergo deduplication and classification, but there is no benchmark-specific or corpus-wide decontamination report, membership test, hash ledger, revision pin, near-duplicate analysis, or false-negative audit. The disclosed training-distribution origin of reward-hacking coding tasks means their results should be interpreted as behavior on known-distribution adversarial tasks rather than unseen-test generalization.

value_zh.html: 训练数据经过去重与分类，但没有基准特定或语料范围的去污染报告、成员测试、哈希账本、修订钉扎、近重复分析或假阴性审计。所披露的奖励劫持编程任务的训练分布来源意味着其结果应解释为已知分布对抗任务上的行为，而非未见测试泛化。

items: Training-source proportions, named datasets, record counts, dates beyond the public-internet cutoff, and item-level provenance are absent; the five source classes cannot be converted into a quantitative mixture.
RLHF and RLAIF identify technique families only; preference labels, AI-feedback model, reward model, objective weights, optimization details, and calibration are undisclosed.

Crowd workers perform preference selection, safety evaluation, and adversarial testing, but the report does not partition their contributions among training, development, and evaluation or disclose rater agreement and adjudication.

Reward-Hack-Prone Coding Tasks v2 is drawn from the training distribution and hand-selected for prior hacking, so its 6% classifier and 3% hidden-test rates are not clean measures of unseen-task generalization.
The hidden tests are held out only within the named reward-hacking evaluation; this does not establish a global train/eval boundary or benchmark decontamination.
Prompt-injection performance combines checkpoint behavior with model-level instructions, FileRead changes, and classifiers; scores with safeguards cannot be attributed solely to model training.

Reasoning faithfulness lacks a reliable metric for recent well-aligned models. Not observing unambiguous unfaithfulness in available audits is not evidence that user-visible or internal reasoning is faithful.
Rare long thoughts may be summarized by a second model at inference, so the displayed trace can differ from the complete generated trace and should not be treated as an exact reasoning record.

The later-stage RL behavior review reports recursive coverage of all behavior but releases neither raw transcripts nor summaries, judge prompts, scores, counts, calibration, or sampling/checkpoint identifiers.

RSP results sometimes report the highest-scoring of multiple snapshots, including helpful-only versions, rather than only the released snapshot; capability scores and release-checkpoint behavior must be distinguished.
No reusable data, model weights, reward code, global split audit, source-license ledger, or item-level training lineage is released.
训练来源比例、具名数据集、记录计数、公开互联网截止日期之外的日期，以及条目级谱系缺失；五类来源无法转换为定量混合物。
RLHF 与 RLAIF 仅标识技术族；偏好标签、AI 反馈模型、奖励模型、目标权重、优化细节与校准未披露。
众包工作者执行偏好选择、安全评测与对抗测试，但报告不将其贡献划分到训练、开发与评测，也不披露评分者一致性与裁决。
Reward-Hack-Prone Coding Tasks v2 取自训练分布并因先前黑客而手选，故其 6% 分类器与 3% 隐藏测试比率不是未见任务泛化的干净度量。
隐藏测试仅在具名奖励劫持评测内留出；这不确立全局训练/评测边界或基准去污染。
提示注入表现结合检查点行为与模型级指令、FileRead 变更及分类器；带防护的分数不能仅归因于模型训练。
推理忠实性对近期良好对齐模型缺少可靠指标。在可得审计中未观察到明确不忠实，并非用户可见或内部推理忠实的证据。
罕见长思考可能在推断时由第二模型摘要，故展示轨迹可与完整生成轨迹不同，不应视为精确推理记录。
后期 RL 行为审查报告对全部行为的递归覆盖，但既不发布原始转录也不发布摘要、评审提示、分数、计数、校准或采样/检查点标识符。
RSP 结果有时报告多个快照中得分最高者，包括仅有用版本，而非仅已发布快照；必须区分能力分数与发布检查点行为。
未发布可复用数据、模型权重、奖励代码、全局划分审计、来源许可账本或条目级训练谱系。
